author: KEXP
description: South London's Dry Cleaning return to the KEXP Live Room with their third studio album 'Secret Love.' Balancing social commentary and playful art rock, the post-punk quartet deliver a performance of "Hit My Head All Day" and more with host Cheryl Waters.
title: Dry Cleaning performs "Hit My Head All Day" & more Live on KEXP
